changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Refreshed the immutable model snapshot after four README-only commits; all executable artifacts and runtime pins are unchanged.
Kept the derived TP1 and K64 cache namespace on the unchanged executable payload revision to avoid rebuilding identical data.
Added a complete single-Spark Candidate for the public REAP-K216 EXL3/Trellis checkpoint and exact SparkInfer TP1 image.
The offline adapter uses the immutable snapshot, writes namespaced TP1 and K64 draft state under /outputs, and performs no runtime download.
The recipe remains Candidate until a Vonk-managed physical single-Spark import, boot, inference, and structured-output canary is recorded.
